title: Zuweisen
hint: Allows teachers to assign tasks, collect student work (files & text), and provide feedback/grades.
reason: Directly addresses task assignment, submission and grading - a core function for many learning scenarios.

title: BigBlueButton
hint: Provides a web conferencing platform for live online classes, virtual office hours, and group collaboration.
reason: Supports real-time interaction and collaboration, crucial for many educational activities.

title: Forum
hint: Enables text-based, real-time synchronous discussions among participants.
reason: Facilitates communication and discussion, especially useful for remote learning or group projects.

title: Abstimmung
hint: Allows teachers to link to external URLs (websites, files) for various purposes.
reason: Useful for providing links to resources or activities outside the platform.

title: Gruppenarbeit
hint: Facilitates collection, review, and peer assessment of student work.
reason: Supports collaborative learning and feedback processes.

title: Buch
hint: Creates multi-page resources with chapters, subchapters, text & media for displaying information.
reason: Useful for presenting lengthy content in a structured and organized manner.

title: Wiki
hint: Enables collaborative creation and editing of web pages.
reason: Suitable for group notes, shared documents, or collaborative projects.
